claim.claim-text: 2. The spinal implant system of claim 1, wherein an outer surface of the upper arcuate lip and an outer surface of the lower arcuate lip are spaced apart from and extend generally parallel to an outer wall of the pin of the spinal implant that is exposed through the recessed slot of the implant body.
3. The spinal implant system of claim 1, wherein the ipsilateral face of the implant body is parallel to the vertical pivot axis.
4. The spinal implant system of claim 1, wherein the vertical pivot axis is located between the anterior face and the posterior face and between the ipsilateral face and the contralateral face.

5. The spinal implant system of claim 1, wherein the implant body has a longitudinal length that extends from the ipsilateral face to the contralateral face and that is configured to be arranged parallel to the coronal plane of the intervertebral disc space.

6. The spinal implant system of claim 1, wherein the implant body has a maximum width that extends from the posterior face to the anterior face and that is configured to be arranged parallel to a medial plane of the intervertebral disc space.

7. The spinal implant system of claim 1, wherein the anterior face of the implant body has a front maximum height and the posterior face of the implant body has a rear maximum height, wherein the rear maximum height is less than the front maximum height, wherein the implant body tapers in height from the front maximum height of the anterior face to the rear maximum height of the posterior face.

8. The spinal implant system of claim 1, wherein the implant body further includes a tissue ingrowth window extending through the top bearing face and the bottom bearing face, the tissue ingrowth window located between the anterior face and the posterior face and between the contralateral face and the ipsilateral face.

9. The spinal implant system of claim 1, further comprising a multi-blade retractor having at least first and second retractor blades that are sized to establish the oblique anterolateral retroperitoneal operative corridor to the intervertebral disc space.

11. The spinal implant system of claim 10, wherein an outer surface of the upper arcuate lip and an outer surface of the lower arcuate lip are spaced apart from and extend generally parallel to an outer wall of the pin of the spinal implant that is exposed through the recessed slot of the implant body.
12. The spinal implant system of claim 10, wherein the ipsilateral face of the implant body is parallel to the vertical pivot axis.
13. The spinal implant system of claim 10, wherein the vertical pivot axis is located between the anterior face and the posterior face and between the ipsilateral face and the contralateral face.

14. The spinal implant system of claim 10, wherein the implant body has a longitudinal length that extends from the ipsilateral face to the contralateral face and that is configured to be arranged parallel to the coronal plane of the intervertebral disc space.

15. The spinal implant system of claim 10, wherein the implant body has a maximum width that extends from the posterior face to the anterior face and that is configured to be arranged parallel to a medial plane of the intervertebral disc space.

16. The spinal implant system of claim 10, wherein the anterior face of the implant body has a front maximum height and the posterior face of the implant body has a rear maximum height, wherein the rear maximum height is less than the front maximum height, wherein the implant body tapers in height from the front maximum height of the anterior face to the rear maximum height of the posterior face.

17. The spinal implant system of claim 10, wherein the implant body further includes a tissue ingrowth window extending through the top bearing face and the bottom bearing face, the tissue ingrowth window located between the anterior face and the posterior face and between the contralateral face and the ipsilateral face.

18. The spinal implant system of claim 10, further comprising a multi-blade retractor having at least first and second retractor blades that are sized to establish the oblique anterolateral retroperitoneal operative corridor to the intervertebral disc space.
